newsitem.title: USA: Senate to vote on Barshefsky nomination Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Senate to vote on Barshefsky nomination Wednesday.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott scheduled a vote Wednesday afternoon on the nomination of Charlene Barshefsky to be U.S. Trade Representative.
The Senate will also vote on a bill waiving a potential conflict of interest for Barshefsky because she once represented Canada on a trade issue before joining the USTR's office.
